name: Empire DVC20 Innsbrook NG Fireplace Insert - IPI
description: The Empire DVC20 Innsbrook Direct Vent Traditional Gas Insert will fit right inside a pre-existing fireplace giving your hearth a whole new style. This gas fireplace insert is compatible with either propane or natural gas and includes a blower to maximize the heat output of your unit. The included barrier screen will give you peace as it will prevent you from coming in contact with the glass. There are various control options that give you the ability to mange your fires with a wireless remote control or wall switch. Complete the look of the Empire DVC20 Innsbrook Direct Vent Traditional Gas Insert by selecting one of the many surrounds to give your fireplace a seamless style. Surrounds are available in a sleek matte black finish or classic bronze. This unit can produce up to 20,500 BTUs keeping you and your family toasty and warm on chilly days. You can customize the interior of your insert by adding one of the traditional liners or a modern black porcelain liner. Features: Includes a barrier screen and blower Can produce up to 20,500 BTUs Viewing Area: 25.25 inch W x 11.125 inch H Millivolt and Intermittent Pilot ignitions are available Made in the USA
